newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up on back of blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up on back of blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Friday as retail investors bought blue chips in anticipation of an upward movement of the index in January, brokers said.

The all shares index closed 3.4 points up at 599.2. Price gains led declines by 16 to nine. Blue chips Commercial Bank rose nine rupees to 125, Grain Elevators 1.50 to 13.75, Hatton National Bank 10 to 250, National Development Bank one to 196.
"Retail investors believe the index is about to start moving up, and want to get in before that," said Dimuthu Abeysekera a trader at Allied Phillips Securities.
The year is ending on improved investor sentiment, which should serve to push up the index in 1997, he said.
With corporte results in 1997 expected to be better than 1996, which was badly hit by power cuts, small investors want to beat institutional investors to the bargains, brokers said.
Turnover was 13.4 million rupees, on 1.3 million shares.
